summary: The milestone completed 13 experiments in 24.4 minutes, including 4 compute-bound experiments. The compute-bound experiments in the locked slowest list were the 9.94-minute Live ARC generalization task, the 4.72-minute Qwen3.8 source comparison, and the 1.0-minute live ARC identity repair. No data available this milestone explains their internal phase costs.
bottlenecks_identified: Live ARC generalization after strict identity repair was the longest listed experiment at 9.94 minutes; no data available this milestone identifies which internal phase caused that duration.

Fresh Qwen3.8 source comparison with valid equal-budget controls was the next-longest listed compute-bound experiment at 4.72 minutes; no data available this milestone separates model loading, inference, validation, or artifact overhead.
Matched durability throughput and acknowledgment-latency frontier took 6.01 minutes but was synthesis-only, so its duration is not a GPU-utilization bottleneck.

The point-in-time GPU state is not joined to experiment execution windows, so it cannot establish compute-task utilization efficiency or whether any task was eligible for multi-model parallel dispatch.
improvements_suggested: Emit experiment-scoped phase timers for model loading, inference, validation, and artifact writing so the cause of long compute-bound runs is measurable.
Capture GPU utilization samples only within compute-task boundaries and join them to the experiment name, process, model count, and runner choice.
Add a launch receipt that records whether a task loads one model or at least two models in parallel; select DualGPURunner only for the latter case.
Use an eligibility-aware device queue to place independent single-model compute tasks on separate GPUs when dependencies permit, and release task-owned model memory after completion.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-window GPU telemetry and phase timers to every compute-bound experiment.
Record model count, concurrency eligibility, selected runner, and dispatch reason at launch.
Schedule independent single-model compute tasks across separate GPUs when ready, without forcing DualGPURunner onto single-model work.
meta_reflection: The reconstructed timings rank the expensive work but do not explain its internal cost, and the endpoint GPU snapshot cannot be attributed to compute-task windows. No data available this milestone shows a compute-bound task with at least two parallel models that failed to engage DualGPURunner.
